scripts.dev:backend:if-free: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'Backend already running on port 4000; reusing it.' } else { npm run dev:backend }"
scripts.dev:ai:if-free: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Host 'AI service already running on port 8000; reusing it.' } else { npm run dev:ai }"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend,ai --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend:if-free" "npm run dev:ai:if-free"
